parsed.why: Decriminalised, anti-discrimination on orientation but not GI; recent police assault/detention of trans woman; shadow report documents persistent discrimination and under-investigated violence; no LGR or facilities data.

Self-declaration LGR, marriage equality, broad anti-discrimination, action plan; but rising LGBTIQ hate-crime reports (raw, no denominator), hate-crime law may omit GI, cantonal detention rules; no trans-specific violence data.

Same-sex conduct criminalised with documented state torture, mental-hospital confinement and impunity; trans people unrecognised, so trans woman with male documents falls within statute; no anti-discrimination; state-owned media obscures frequency.

Explicit cross-dressing offence enforced with prison sentences; border strip-search of genderqueer visitor; gender-affirming care banned; felony deportation; documented arrests of foreign expat — direct state-imposed exposure for visibly gender-nonconforming travellers.

No criminalisation and GI anti-discrimination, but hostile public opinion, official minister hostility, lethal 2022 attack on LGBT bar and no progress after; restrictive LGR and no relationship recognition; single attack weighs heavily.
